name: BookshelfNG
description: Standalone NG fork of Bookshelf for ebook and audiobook management, with optional SeerrNG integration. One instance can handle both formats.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent BookshelfNG database, settings, and logs.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Downloads shared with the configured download client.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Web UI Port for the standalone web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for files created by this service.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for files created by this service.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Time zone used by this service.

variables.name: HARDCOVER
variables.description: Enable Hardcover metadata for this image.

variables.name: HARDCOVER_AUTH
variables.description: Personal Hardcover API token, including the Bearer prefix. Can also be entered in BookshelfNG settings.
